newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Inkombank joins EBRD, Cyprus bank in south.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Inkombank joins EBRD, Cyprus bank in south.

text.p: AB Inkombank said on Friday it had formed a new bank with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and Cyprus Development Bank Ltd to invest and operate in southern Russia.
The Cyprus Development Bank will take 49.98 percent of the $10 million of Investitsionny Bank Kuban, and Inkombank and the EBRD will each hold 25.01 percent, an Inkombank statement said.

IB Kuban will be based in the southern Russian city of Krasnodar. It will focus on project finance in the Krasnodar, Stavropol and Rostov farming regions, helping agricultural and small and medium-sized businesses.
Inkombank has a branch in Cyprus as well as 49 branches in Russia, a Swiss subsidiary and representative offices in China, Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Britain.
Inkombank has said it intends to sell a stake to the EBRD and to an unnamed German bank. Officials said a 20-percent stake could be sold in March or April.
Officials said Inkombank also intends to acquire 10 percent of Belarus's Prior Bank.
